definitions.explanation: Describes something brilliantly beautiful, elaborate, and impressive. Often used for elegant, showy displays of beauty or skill.

examples.japanese: {華麗|かれい}な⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧
{華麗|かれい}な⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}した→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: She captivated the audience with her brilliant technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{華麗|かれい}な⟦{装飾|そうしょく}→装飾：14104_soushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呑|の}んだ。
examples.english: Visitors gasped at the palace's magnificent decorations.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {華麗|かれい}な⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {華麗|かれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (splendidly, magnificently)

NUANCE: {華麗|かれい} suggests dazzling, elaborate beauty - something that impresses with its brilliance and splendor. It can describe physical beauty, artistic performance, or elegant actions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {華麗|かれい}な⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧/⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧ (gorgeous costume/dress)
- {華麗|かれい}な⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ (brilliant technique)
- {華麗|かれい}な⟦{装飾|そうしょく}→装飾：14104_soushoku⟧ (magnificent decoration)
- {華麗|かれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変身|へんしん}する→変身する：25383_henshinsuru⟧ (to transform splendidly)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ (luxurious, gorgeous)
- ⟦{絢爛|けんらん}→絢爛：09200_kenran⟧ (gorgeous, brilliant)
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (beautiful - more common)
- ⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧ (simple, plain - opposite)
